=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- changelog.d/4450-check-in-hand-back-to-pushing-session.md:12 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says the check-in interval is 180 minutes or 3-hourly, while the implemented and documented interval is 60 minutes.
  WHY: Operators will expect check-ins every three hours although the checker runs hourly.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2323-2345 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The early scope check compares the working tree with the pre-loop snapshot and can classify changes from a non-scope failure or unrelated drift as an out-of-scope edit.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree whether this can trigger restoration of valid progress or only misattribute the failure in the log; the highest reported severity is high.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:793-804 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The resolver writes manifest.json directly rather than atomically, so interruption can leave invalid JSON that prevents later resolver attempts from recovering.
  WHY: The next check or restore reads the manifest and can exit with a JSONDecodeError if the write was interrupted.
- .claude/scripts/stale_routines.py:95-140 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A terminal PR response without merged_at or closed_at produces an unclear timestamp error instead of a specific diagnostic.
  WHY: Reviewers disagree whether the exception is unhandled; the other reports say it is caught and the Routine is kept safely, but the resulting diagnostic is opaque.
- tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_retry_prelude_render.py:53-55 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The test import block contains duplicate import os statements despite the editor summary claiming only one remained.
  WHY: The duplicate import is tolerated at runtime but may be flagged by lint tools.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:737 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The _resolver_attempt_state Python block imports shutil but never uses it despite the editor summary claiming it was removed.
  WHY: The unused import is tolerated at runtime but may be flagged by lint tools.
- .claude/scripts/stale_routines.py:143-170 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A failed GitHub PR lookup keeps the Routine and reports an error without retrying or backing off.
  WHY: Repeated transient failures can keep producing the same error until GitHub recovers or the dead-man's switch fires.
- .claude/hooks/pr_check_in_reminder.py:71-96 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The reminder only instructs the session to run the stale Routine sweep and does not invoke or deterministically enforce it.
  WHY: If the model skips the instruction, Routines can accumulate despite the §26.G sweep requirement.
- docs/INVENTORY.md | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: docs/INVENTORY.md lacks entries for the workflow and scripts added by the merge commit.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py fails, causing the required CI/lint check to fail and blocking merge.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- changelog.d/4450-check-in-hand-back-to-pushing-session.md:12 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment says the check-in interval is 180 minutes, but every other code path that documents or implements the cadence uses 60 minutes.
  WHY: Operators reading the changelog expect a 3-hourly cadence while the actual cadence is hourly.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:2323-2345 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The early scope check compares the post-attempt tree against the snapshot captured before the first attempt, so unrelated drift can be classified as a scope violation.
  WHY: A timeout, OOM, model API error, or unrelated tool writing a sibling file can cause the retry log to falsely attribute the failure to an out-of-scope edit.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:793-804 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: `manifest_file.write_text(json.dumps({...}))` writes manifest.json directly without an atomic rename.
  WHY: An interrupted capture can leave partial JSON that causes the next check or restore to fail with JSONDecodeError and exit 2.
- .claude/scripts/stale_routines.py:128-140 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: When `pr.get("merged") == True` but `pr.get("merged_at")` is `None`, `_parse_time(None)` raises an unclear ValueError.
  WHY: The caller catches it, so the Routine is kept safely, but the diagnostic is opaque.
- tests/test_review_conflict_resolve_retry_prelude_render.py:53-55 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The import block contains two `import os` statements.
  WHY: Python tolerates duplicate imports, but the editor summary claimed one remained and lint tools may flag the duplicate.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:737 | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  PROBLEM: The `_resolver_attempt_state` Python block imports `shutil` but never references it.
  WHY: Python tolerates the unused import, but the editor summary claimed it had been removed and lint tools may flag it.
- .claude/scripts/stale_routines.py:143-170 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: A failed `gh_api` call for an enabled hand-back's PR keeps the Routine and reports the error, but the sweep does not retry or back off.
  WHY: Repeated 403s or transient 5xx failures can produce the same error until GitHub recovers; the Routine remains preserved.
- .claude/hooks/pr_check_in_reminder.py:71-96 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: The post-push reminder hook only emits text as `additionalContext`; it never invokes the script or MCP tool.
  WHY: If the model skips the sweep instruction, Routines can accumulate indefinitely.

Requirement: "The targeted suites pass: check-in, reminder, watch guard, implement-plan, changelog, and workflow size." (PR description's Tests section.)
Expected change site: Either `docs/INVENTORY.md` needs entries for `.github/workflows/claude-issue-intake.yml`, `scripts/claude_issue_route.py`, `scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh`, and `scripts/claude_issue_intake.sh`; OR the PR description's Tests section must reflect that `lint` (the `tests/inventory_parity.py` check) is failing on the current head with those four missing entries, so future readers know why the suite list omits it.
Evidence of absence: `tests/inventory_parity.py` (the failing CI check) lists exactly those four paths as missing in `pr_check_runs_context.txt failed[0].log_tail` (lines 8-12 of the captured tail: `FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Workflows: missing .github/workflows/claude-issue-intake.yml`; `FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/claude_issue_route.py`; `FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/claude_issue_handoff.sh`; `FAIL: docs/INVENTORY.md: Scripts: missing scripts/claude_issue_intake.sh`). These files were added by the prior merge commit `7ed38e8` (`[ai-merge-resolve] resolve merge conflicts`) which is the PR head. The current PR's own `pr_changed_files.txt` does not include `docs/INVENTORY.md` — the inventory drift was inherited from the prior commit, not introduced by this PR, but the PR fails to fix it and the PR description's Tests section does not mention the failing `lint` job.
